text: きれいな　ぎんいろに　ひかる　すこし　ちいさめの　しんじゅ。

structure.jp: きれいな　ぎんいろに　ひかる
すこし　ちいさめの

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きれいな　ぎんいろに　ひかる　すこし　ちいさめの　しんじゅ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put before a thing, tells you what kind of thing it is. ぎんいろに　ひかる　しんじゅ = 'a Pearl that shines silver'.

patterns.name: 〜め
patterns.explanation: め added to a describing word with its い dropped means 'a bit on that side'. ちいさめ = 'on the small side'.
